open_questions: Two compounding issues per six agreeing dealer/reference sources: (1) the 1982 nickel-brass 2 drachmes with new spelling is KM#130, not KM#117 (KM#117 is the 1976-1980 Karaiskakis issue); (2) the portrait is Georgios Karaiskakis, not Manto Mavrogenous - her 2 drachmes is a separate 1988-2000 copper type. Verify both against the coin.
